visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young individuals (one male on the left, two females on the right) stand in a neutral indoor room with arms crossed, staring directly at the camera. The male wears a black mask, a white/blue patterned fleece, and pink trousers; the middle female wears a grey zip-up hoodie; the female on the right wears a pink cropped top and a white ruffled skirt. (2) The middle female places her arms over the shoulders of the other two, and they begin a synchronized rhythmic dance. They lift their knees and bounce their upper bodies in a repetitive motion, maintaining serious expressions initially. The background consists of a plain white wall and a window with a grey blind. (3) The synchronization breaks as they all burst into laughter. The male retreats into the background, the middle female leans forward while giggling, and the female on the right hides her face while laughing. The lighting remains bright and even throughout the indoor setting.
